title: Rabbi Yishmael ben Luga
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Yoma 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.38a.14), Rabbi Akiva recounts: “Rabbi Yishmael ben Luga told me: Once I went out, I and one of their grandchildren (of those who compounded the incense in the Temple), etc.” And in the Jerusalem Talmud, Shekalim ch. 5, halakha 2, they read "Shimon ben Luga," and in [Yoma ch. 3, halakha 9](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yoma.3.9.4), "Shimon ben Lagas."

notes.text: The Bavli narrator Yishmael is Shimon in the two Jerusalem Talmud citations; Luga and Lagas also differ. The parenthesis about the incense preparers is Hyman’s.

In [Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:9:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Yoma.3.9.4), Guggenheimer’s text preserves Lagas in parentheses and marks Loga as the correction. Both readings are attached to Shimon. [Yoma 38a:14](https://www.sefaria.org/Yoma.38a.14) has Yishmael ben Luga. The reported Shekalim locator is left as supplied.
